0])\nPY\"", "aggregated_output": "36:## Usage limits\n38:The hosted app uses a daily credit system to power AI features like chat.
\n40:* **Guests** get a free daily usage allowance. Higher-priced models are greyed out in the model picker with a \"Sign in to us
e this model\" tooltip. Sign in to unlock them. The sidebar shows a progress bar with how much of your daily limit you've used and
when it resets. When you reach the limit, you'll be prompted to sign in.\n42:* **Signed-in users** get **10×** the daily usage of
a guest. Your daily usage and any paid credit balance are visible in the account menu at the bottom of the sidebar.\n43:* **Paid
credits** can be topped up from the billing page and are shown alongside your daily limit in the account menu.\n44:* **Low credits
warning**: when your credit balance drops to 10% or below, the sidebar credit meter turns red and shows a **Low credits** label.\
n45:* **When credits run out**, only the free hosted models are locked. Models you access with your own API key (BYOK) remain avai
lable regardless of your credit balance.\n47:When your credit balance reaches zero, free models are grayed out in the model picker
so you can see the limit before sending a message. Models from your own API keys remain available. If you have paid top-up credit
s, free models stay enabled even after your daily free allowance is exhausted.\n51:Open the **account menu** at the bottom of the
sidebar (click your avatar or email) and choose **Sign out**. You'll be returned to the public app as a guest, and any signed-in u
sage allowance is replaced by the guest allowance until you sign back in.\n106:## Billing\n110:The **Payment history** card on the
org billing page lists your recent credit top-ups. Each row shows:\n121:To add credits, click **Top up**, either from the empty s
tate when you have no history, or from the credit balance card above.\n125:> **Free plan organizations cannot purchase credits dir
ectly.** If your organization is on the Free plan, the Top up dialog shows a message that only an organization owner can upgrade t
he plan, with a **Compare plans** button. Clicking it closes the dialog and opens your organization's Plans settings so you can up
grade.\n129:> **Desktop app:** When you confirm a top-up in the desktop app, checkout opens in your default system browser and the
dialog closes automatically. Your credit balance updates in the app once the purchase completes, so no redirect back into the app
is required.\n133:Auto-reload buys credits automatically when your balance runs low. It isn't\n134:available on the Free plan. Op
en it\n135:from **Auto-reload → Manage** on the credit balance card and set:\n137:* **Credits to add**: how many credits each refi
ll buys, from 500 to 1,000,000.\n147:### Managing billing details\n149:Organization owners on a paid plan see a **Manage billing**
button on the billing page. Clicking it opens the Stripe portal where you can update payment methods, download invoices, add tax
IDs, and review billing details. Only organization owners can access this portal.\n153:When someone you invited to a paid-seat org
anization signs up and the automatic seat charge fails or is cancelled, the org billing page shows a **Seat payment didn't go thro
